description.en: Alpha source preview for DSH Web 0.2.1-alpha.2: adds collapsible cross-project pinned Session groups alongside Workspace. Reuses native pins without changing project ownership or cwd. npm publication and real mouse drag-and-drop acceptance are pending.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH Web 0.2.1-alpha.2 的 alpha 源码预览：在工作区同级区域提供可折叠的跨项目置顶 Session 分组，复用原生置顶，不改变项目归属或 cwd。npm 发布和真实鼠标拖放验收尚未完成。
